newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr ends stronger, helped by options buying.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr ends stronger, helped by options buying.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed stronger on Wednesday at C$1.3811 (US$0.7241) in heavy trading. * Dealers said buying was linked to the expiry of options today as well as foreigners purchasing dollars in order to buy Canadian equities. * Outlook for the currency seen bullish after breaking through C$1.3820 (US$0.7236) level.
The Canadian dollar initially strengthened overnight after the Reserve Bank of Australia surprised markets by cutting its official cash rate by half a percentage point to 5.0 percent.

The overnight rate move helped the Canada unit to break through the key C$1.3820 (US$0.7236) level later on Wednesday. Analysts said the fact the currency was able to do so is a bullish indicator for the unit.
"You're probably looking for a move down to C$1.3760 (US$0.7267)," said Farrill.
Analysts said speculation that the Bank of Canada will hike interest rates for the second time this year has waned in view of the stronger Canadian dollar.
On the crosses, Canada's dollar rose to 1.3286 marks from Tuesday's close of 1.3263 marks and rose to 85.59 yen from 85.44 yen.
